scope: Actual local Rust BFT Node, adopted native-execution implementation, signed QCs, immutable Circle pool, encrypted operator wallet and the shared HTTP/WireGuard service without a TUN. Same-node service binding and guarded handoff callback are exercised; physical shielded traffic and public networks are not.
implemented: Wallet supplies canonical traffic Authority and already-prepaid Settlement acknowledgements; a usage signature cannot buy bytes or trigger public purchase
Private channel credits are revalidated against actual canonical note history, with cached epoch/count/clock floors retained for each live grant
One exact revocable/fresh publication guards nonblocking packet handoff; original tariff can outlive rate notice but stopped generation cannot forward
Funds::Channel carries public available OCT; Funds::Shielded carries quote ceiling and credited price, with mode mismatch refused before meter or transport creation
Separate domain-signed private status binds connection, operator generation, quote ceiling, purchased/delivered/held counters and canonical clock; service slot pins delivery counters only
Only shielded connect/status/stock-connect/usage routes are mounted for the private service; public payment routes are absent
Private HTTP binds loopback only behind authenticated TLS; public listener misconfiguration refuses before service state creation
Node::bind_shielded requires wallet and browser/VPN to share the same node publication; another publication is refused before binding
Control/transport may run without a TUN; an internet exit explicitly supplies Some(IpTunnelConfig)
Paid service shutdown revokes packet admission, signals HTTP keep-alive connections, cancels incomplete request bodies/handlers and bounds drain; caller cancellation sends the same signal
canonical_test: Real private note payment precedes any byte capacity; speculative proof and uncovered usage fail
Private HTTP connects and acknowledges confirmed finite purchase through the exact existing encrypted meter, preserving prior consumed bytes
Signed private status validates; public /payments/connect is absent; over-purchase acknowledgement fails
New publication revokes a held handoff guard; fresh guard restores only the existing purchase entitlement
Second real payment to one invoice remains an owned note without duplicate capacity
Native browser/VPN binding refuses detached publication and exposed raw HTTP before state creation
Private wallet recovery succeeds after same-node service stop while reqwest client remains alive
Canonical/ExEx-store reopen preserves paid bytes; retired operator obtains no live forwarding capability

prior_test_failure.cause: Aborting the paid control acceptor left Router clones in live keep-alive tasks, retaining the wallet lease after service shutdown.
prior_test_failure.fix: Signal graceful connection shutdown and cancel pending handlers before bounding the drain. Actual TCP idle/incomplete-body clients remain open in both explicit-stop and caller-abort regressions. The original canonical wallet reopen test now passes unchanged in its ownership expectation.

remaining: Private invoice/purchase transport, payer/client encrypted journal and route-runner integration
Zero-price grants without dummy paid notes and private service-equivocation claims
Automatic key custody/backup tooling and spending received wallet notes through the wallet API
Concurrent root scheduling/retries and funded private multi-node/kernel/restart qualification
Public devnet/mainnet and alternate-host qualification, production ceremony and adversarial cryptographic review
limits: Signed private status is an operator snapshot, not an independent chain proof or physical delivery proof
Current private status is not accepted by the public-plan service slashing path
HTTP control is loopback plaintext and requires the host authenticated TLS transport for network access
Preserve one stable transport directory per wallet; encryption does not detect privileged rollback or cloned wallet/meter copies
Keys remain separately supplied API inputs; no production key custody or setup ceremony is claimed
Existing released shielded_required route remains refused before reading keys or journals
No deployment, public source compilation or GitHub push in this stage

prior_native_qualification.scope: Pool cryptographic/AML sources unchanged; this stage validates host admission and lifecycle, not full upstream epoch parity.

macos_build_env.note: Command-scoped existing toolchain; no global Xcode setting or license acceptance changed
